description: Daily US fuel prices from the public AAA Fuel Gauge (gasprices.aaa.com). Choose the national average, all state averages, or metro/county averages, then filter and page through the results.

fuelTypes.description: Which grades to keep in each record. E85 is published only for the national average, so a state/metro record has no E85 field.
fuelTypes.title: Fuel grades in each record

includeChangeMetrics.description: When history is available, add changeFromYesterday, changeFromWeekAgo, changeFromMonthAgo, and changeFromYearAgo in cents for the primary fuel.
includeChangeMetrics.title: Include derived change fields

includeHistory.description: Add yesterday, week-ago, month-ago, and year-ago averages. In state mode this reads each selected state's page, so it takes one politely spaced request per state; in metro and national modes the history is already on the fetched page.
includeHistory.sectionDescription: Control ordering, record history, and how many records a run returns.
includeHistory.title: Include price history

maxItems.description: The page size: the maximum number of records this run returns. Use startIndex to read the next page.
maxItems.title: Records per page

maxPrice.description: Drop records whose primary fuel is more expensive than this. Records without that grade are kept, because the source has no price to compare.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD per gallon)

metroNameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substrings, e.g. New York or Los Angeles. Only used in metro mode; leave empty for every metro.
metroNameFilter.title: Metro name contains

minPrice.description: Drop records whose primary fuel is cheaper than this. Records without that grade are kept, because the source has no price to compare.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD per gallon)

mode.description: National average = one US record. State averages = 50 states + DC. Metro/county averages = every metro area AAA lists on the pages of the states you choose.
mode.sectionDescription: One run can return the national figure, the state table, or metro rows for selected states.
mode.title: What to scrape

primaryFuelType.description: The grade that minPrice, maxPrice, sortBy, and the derived change fields use. E85 is available on the national average only.
primaryFuelType.title: Fuel grade used by price filters and sorting

sortBy.description: How the matching records are ordered before pagination. Price sorts put records without the primary fuel at the end.
enumTitles: Primary fuel price, most expensive first
sortBy.title: Sort records by

startIndex.description: How many matching records to skip before this page. 0 starts at the beginning; combine with maxItems to page through a large result set.
startIndex.title: Pagination start index

states.description: Two-letter codes (NY, CA, TX) or state names (New York). Leave empty for all 50 states + DC. In metro mode this decides which state pages are read.
states.sectionDescription: All filters are optional. Leave a filter empty to keep every record.
states.title: States

title: US Gas Price Tracker Input
